test_title: SSC CPO 2024 Official Paper-I (Held On: 29 Jun, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
The following sentence has been divided into parts. One of them may contain an error. Select the part that contains the error from the given options. If you don’t find any error, mark ‘No error’ as your answer.

When Ramu was working / as a clerk, / he asked me money.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the omission of the preposition "**for**" after the verb "**asked**."
 
• When asking someone for something, the correct structure is "ask **for** something".
 
• The correct phrase should be "**he asked me for money**," ensuring grammatical correctness and clarity.
 
• Thus, the error is located in **part 4** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"When Ramu was working as a clerk, **he asked me for money**."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **1: "When Ramu was working" **– This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **2: "as a clerk," **– This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **3: "No error"** – This would be the correct option if there were no mistakes in the sentence, but there is an error in part 4.
